result.summary: Found a misspelled search placeholder and minor visual inconsistencies with favorite icons and horizontal carousel edge clipping.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
Favorite heart icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has no background container while the pizza card below shows a dark circular background behind the heart, making the style inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark circular button background, size, and padding to all favorite/heart icons for consistency and touch target.

issues.description: Title 'Trattoria Piccol' in 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped mid-letter at the screen edge and the far-right category filter chip is partially cut off with no end padding.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal list end-padding and ensure off-screen titles use ellipsis truncation rather than mid-character clipping.
